mapper.insert: insert into im_conversation_member (conversation_id, member_id, role, unread_count, last_read_msg_id, muted, deleted, create_time) values (#{conversationId}, #{memberId}, #{role}, 0, 0, 0, 0, sysdate())
mapper.select: select id, conversation_id, member_id, role, unread_count, last_read_msg_id, muted, deleted, create_time from im_conversation_member where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and member_id = #{memberId} limit 1

select id, conversation_id, member_id, role, unread_count, last_read_msg_id, muted, deleted, create_time from im_conversation_member where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and member_id = #{memberId} limit 1 for update
mapper.update: update im_conversation_member m join im_conversation c on c.id = m.conversation_id and c.status = 0 set m.unread_count = m.unread_count + #{delta} where m.conversation_id = #{conversationId} and m.member_id = #{memberId} and m.deleted = 0
mapper.select: select m.id, m.conversation_id, m.member_id, m.role, m.unread_count, m.last_read_msg_id, m.muted, m.deleted, m.create_time from im_conversation_member m join im_conversation c on c.id = m.conversation_id where m.member_id = #{memberId} and m.deleted = 0 and c.status = 0 order by c.last_msg_at desc

select m.id, m.conversation_id, m.member_id, m.role, m.unread_count, m.last_read_msg_id, m.muted, m.deleted, m.create_time, c.id as conv_id, c.type as conv_type, c.biz_key as conv_biz_key, c.status as conv_status, msg.id as latest_id, msg.sender_id as latest_sender_id, msg.msg_type as latest_msg_type, msg.content as latest_content, msg.extra_json as latest_extra_json, msg.status as latest_status, msg.check_status as latest_check_status, msg.create_time as latest_create_time, date_format(coalesce(msg.visible_at, msg.create_time), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') as latest_visible_order_at, other.member_id as counterparty_id, u.id as profile_id, u.nickname as profile_nickname, u.name as profile_name, u.avatar as profile_avatar from im_conversation_member m join im_conversation c on c.id = m.conversation_id left join im_message msg on msg.id = ( select id from im_message where conversation_id = c.id and status != 2 and (msg_type != 2 or check_status = 1 or sender_id = #{memberId}) order by coalesce(visible_at, create_time) desc, id desc limit 1) left join im_conversation_member other on other.id = ( select p.id from im_conversation_member p where p.conversation_id = c.id and p.member_id != #{memberId} limit 1) and (c.type is null or c.type not in (2, 3, 4)) left join ums_member u on u.id = other.member_id where m.member_id = #{memberId} and m.deleted = 0 and c.status = 0 order by c.last_msg_at desc

select coalesce(sum(m.unread_count), 0) from im_conversation_member m join im_conversation c on c.id = m.conversation_id and c.status = 0 where m.member_id = #{memberId} and m.deleted = 0 and (m.muted is null or m.muted != 1) and (c.type is null or c.type != 4)
select id, conversation_id, member_id, role, unread_count, last_read_msg_id, muted, deleted, create_time from im_conversation_member where conversation_id = #{conversationId} for update
mapper.update: update im_conversation_member m join im_conversation c on c.id = m.conversation_id and c.status = 0 set m.unread_count = m.unread_count + #{delta}, m.deleted = 0 where m.conversation_id = #{conversationId} and m.member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.sql: select coalesce(visible_at, create_time) from im_message where id = #{lastReadMsgId} and conversation_id = #{conversationId} and status != 2 and (msg_type != 2 or check_status = 1 or sender_id = #{memberId})
mapper.update: update im_conversation_member set last_read_msg_id = #{lastReadMsgId}, last_read_visible_at = coalesce((), '1970-01-01 00:00:00.000000'), unread_count = (select count(*) from im_message msg where msg.conversation_id = #{conversationId} and msg.sender_id != #{memberId} and msg.status != 2 and (msg.msg_type != 2 or msg.check_status = 1) and (coalesce(msg.visible_at, msg.create_time) > coalesce((), '1970-01-01 00:00:00.000000') or (coalesce(msg.visible_at, msg.create_time) = coalesce((), '1970-01-01 00:00:00.000000') and msg.id > #{lastReadMsgId}))) where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and member_id = #{memberId}

update im_conversation_member set last_read_msg_id = #{lastReadMsgId}, last_read_visible_at = #{visibleOrderAt}, unread_count = (select count(*) from im_message msg where msg.conversation_id = #{conversationId} and msg.sender_id != #{memberId} and msg.status != 2 and (msg.msg_type != 2 or msg.check_status = 1) and (coalesce(msg.visible_at, msg.create_time) > #{visibleOrderAt} or (coalesce(msg.visible_at, msg.create_time) = #{visibleOrderAt} and msg.id > #{lastReadMsgId}))) where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and member_id = #{memberId} and deleted = 0 and ((#{lastReadMsgId} = 0 and #{visibleOrderAt} = '1970-01-01 00:00:00.000000') or exists (select 1 from im_message cutoff where cutoff.id = #{lastReadMsgId} and cutoff.conversation_id = #{conversationId} and cutoff.status != 2 and (cutoff.msg_type != 2 or cutoff.check_status = 1 or cutoff.sender_id = #{memberId}) and date_format(coalesce(cutoff.visible_at, cutoff.create_time), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') = #{visibleOrderAt}))

update im_conversation_member m set m.unread_count = greatest(m.unread_count + #{delta}, 0) where m.conversation_id = (select x.conversation_id from im_message x where x.id = #{messageId}) and m.unread_count > 0 and exists (select 1 from im_message msg where msg.id = #{messageId} and msg.conversation_id = m.conversation_id and msg.sender_id != m.member_id and (msg.msg_type != 2 or msg.check_status = 1) and coalesce(msg.visible_at, msg.create_time) >= m.create_time and (coalesce(msg.visible_at, msg.create_time) > coalesce(m.last_read_visible_at, '1970-01-01 00:00:00.000000') or (coalesce(msg.visible_at, msg.create_time) = coalesce(m.last_read_visible_at, '1970-01-01 00:00:00.000000') and msg.id > m.last_read_msg_id)))
mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(m.unread_count), 0) from im_conversation_member m join im_conversation c on c.id = m.conversation_id and c.status = 0 where m.member_id = #{memberId} and m.deleted = 0 and m.muted = 0
mapper.update: update im_conversation_member set deleted = 1 where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and member_id = #{memberId}
update im_conversation_member set deleted = 1, unread_count = 0 where conversation_id = #{conversationId}
update im_conversation_member set muted = #{muted} where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and member_id = #{memberId}
